user.title: Lite Resources
user.description: Set up this integration. After this step, open Settings, Devices & services, Lite Resources. There, select **Add group** in the upper-right corner, or in the entry's three-dot menu. Add one group for each set of devices. A group holds the users that those devices log in as, for example the users of one room's wall panels. Each group has its own dashboards. Everyone outside the groups keeps Home Assistant's normal behaviour.

abort.single_instance_allowed: This integration is already set up.

user.title: Add a group of lite users
user.description: The pages of a group's users load only the resources that the group's dashboards use. They can also get states only for the entities on those dashboards. The integration finds both from the dashboards, and it finds them again when you save a dashboard.

data.name: Group name
data.filter_states: Only send states their dashboards show
data.include_unscannable: Include resources that the integration cannot read

data_description.name: For example 'Workshop kiosks'.
data_description.users: These users get only the resources that their dashboards use and the states that their dashboards show, on each device that logs in as one of them. A user can be in one group only.
data_description.dashboards: Each dashboard that this group's users open. The integration finds the resources and the entities of these dashboards by itself.
data_description.filter_states: Send states only for the entities on their dashboards, for the members of each entity group on those dashboards, such as a light group, and for the entities under Extra entities. This saves a slow device much work. Each other entity shows as unavailable for these users.
data_description.extra_entities: Entities whose states these users also get, although the dashboards do not name them.
data_description.include_unscannable: This integration cannot read a resource that another integration or another site serves. On: the integration sends such a resource (recommended). Off: it does not send one unless it is under Always include. With the option on or off, it does not send a resource whose file has the name of a card that these dashboards do not use.
data_description.always_include: Leave this empty, because the integration finds the resources from the dashboards. Add a resource only if a card fails to load, or if a theme needs a mod that no dashboard names.
data_description.always_exclude: Leave this empty in most cases. The integration never sends a resource that is here, even when a card seems to need it or when the integration cannot read it. This option wins over Always include.

reconfigure.title: Change a group of lite users
reconfigure.description: The open pages of this group's users get the states of the new entities immediately. A page gets a changed resource list at its next page reload. To rename or delete the group, use the three-dot menu at the right of its row.

preview.name: Preview
preview.description: For administrators. For each group, this action shows the resources that the group's pages get and those that they do not get. It shows each card type for which the resource scan finds no resource file. When entity filtering is on for a group, it also shows the entities that the group's pages get. It also gives the reason when entity filtering or resource filtering is off for a group.
